rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: The sixt House ... Judgments appertaining
rules.historical_meaning_only: The original ornamental heading opens a substantive unnumbered sixth-house study, not an independent numbered chapter

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of the Infirmities and Diseases of Bodyes
rules.historical_meaning_only: The section's medical scope is historical illness and humoral temperament rather than physical modern diagnosis

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Signe ascending
rules.historical_meaning_only: The Ascendant's sign is named as a first health/temperament significator

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: and his Lord
rules.historical_meaning_only: Ascendant ruler is separate from ascending sign itself

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun and Moon
rules.historical_meaning_only: Both luminaries are included as historical health factors, not just either one alone

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon ruleth the humours
rules.historical_meaning_only: Moon is associated with humors in Lilly's premodern theory, not modern physiology

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun the Spirit vitall
rules.historical_meaning_only: Sun is associated with alleged vital spirit in period physiology, not an observable measured vital sign

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: sixt house and Lord thereof
rules.historical_meaning_only: Both sixth house and sixth ruler are specified in an additional health source

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Planet or Planets in the sixt
rules.historical_meaning_only: Planets physically occupying sixth are a further distinct significator class

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: seventh house and his Lord
rules.historical_meaning_only: Seventh house and ruler are included because seventh opposes the Ascendant

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Three things materially considerable
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author explicitly introduces three categories for source evaluation rather than one dominant planet

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: strong or weak
rules.historical_meaning_only: The degree of strength/weakness of the significator is criterion one

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: in aspect with Fortunes or not
rules.historical_meaning_only: Benefic aspects are an additional part of criterion one

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: fixed Stars of ill influence
rules.historical_meaning_only: Malevolent fixed-star conjunctions are a further check on proposed health sources

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: free from evill aspects of Saturn and Mars
rules.historical_meaning_only: The second criterion excludes affliction by the two malefics

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Temperament equall or unequall
rules.historical_meaning_only: The third criterion evaluates humoral balance or imbalance, an unvalidated medical category

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: all or most Significators well fortified
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly gives a favorable conclusion when a majority is strong rather than requiring every factor to agree

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: free from hostile aspects of Infortunes
rules.historical_meaning_only: The strong majority favorable outcome is further conditioned on lack of malefic adverse aspects

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: not conjoyned to malevolent fixed Starres
rules.historical_meaning_only: A lack of adverse fixed-star contacts is another explicitly separate favorable qualification

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: sound Bodies and strong
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author alleges sturdy health under the combined favorable profile, without human evidence

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Signe of a Fortune ascend
rules.historical_meaning_only: A fortunate sign rising is singled out for a further alleged anti-illness configuration

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon strong and not afflicted
rules.historical_meaning_only: Moon must also be strong and free of malefic affliction in that configuration

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: not be sickly
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly proposes fewer illnesses under these compound conditions, not a clinical finding

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: all or most Significators weak and unfortunate
rules.historical_meaning_only: The contrary alleged outcome invokes the majority weak or unfortunate, continuing onto next folio

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: many and grievous Infirmities hardly curable
rules.historical_meaning_only: The historic text alleges severe/lasting sickness, not actual disease risk or outcome

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Aphorismes usefull for this House
rules.historical_meaning_only: These are a new subheading within the unnumbered source, not a new numbered chapter

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ascendant and Lord ... intercepted ... unfortunate
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source mentions an unfortunate ascending sign and ruler/intercepted signs as one possible adverse indicator

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord ascendant in sixt or twelfth
rules.historical_meaning_only: An Ascendant ruler located in sixth or twelfth is an alternative alleged illness condition

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: argues a sickly person
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author classifies this configuration as sickness without clinical validation

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ascendant and all Planets in Signes of one Triplicity
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source singles out Ascendant and all planets in one element's triplicity rather than any one isolated planet

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: watry Signes with Flegme
rules.historical_meaning_only: Water-element signs are associated with phlegm and period diseases

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: earthly with Melancholly
rules.historical_meaning_only: Earth-element signs are associated with melancholy in humoral theory

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: fiery with Choller ... Anger Heat Whelks Pimples
rules.historical_meaning_only: Fire-element signs are linked with choler and a mix of behavioral and skin effects

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ayery abundance of Blood
rules.historical_meaning_only: Air-element signs are linked with blood abundance in historical humour theory

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord ascendant applying to Lord sixt
rules.historical_meaning_only: First-house ruler applying to sixth-house ruler allegedly indicates native neglecting health

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Native most negligent of his own Health
rules.historical_meaning_only: This is a speculative moral/behavior assertion and not a patient-level judgment

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun in an angle first or tenth
rules.historical_meaning_only: Sun placed in Ascendant or Midheaven is an alleged positive longevity indicator

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: especially in Cancer
rules.historical_meaning_only: The claimed favorable solar condition is said to strengthen especially in Cancer

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: gives long life
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author predicts longevity without quantified ages or independent outcome data

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun in sixt eighth seventh or twelfth
rules.historical_meaning_only: These four other named houses define a negative solar longevity branch

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: few yeers much sickness many afflictions
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author alleges illness and shortened life from that branch, not valid medical prognosis

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun and Moon in ...
rules.historical_meaning_only: A Sun–Moon aspect/relationship is used as a historic infirmity indicator; original glyph/operator is not resolved

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ill coloured people leane and age infirme
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly claims appearance and old-age illness/weakness from the luminary condition

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Madnesse or want of Understanding
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source makes stigmatizing and inaccurate mental-capacity claims with no clinical basis

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon afflicted by Square or Opposition of Saturn
rules.historical_meaning_only: The Moon–Saturn hostile aspects enter the source's lifelong illness clause

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: or with South Node in first or second
rules.historical_meaning_only: A lunar node in specified houses is another possible historical illness condition

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: whole life to be infirme
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author alleges lifelong disease, not an evidence-based prognosis

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fixed Stars of nature of Saturn joyned with the Lights
rules.historical_meaning_only: Saturn-like fixed stars contacting luminaries are additionally said to produce weakness

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: makes lean and infirm people
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source attributes thinness/illness to fixed-star configurations without physiological evidence

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars elevated above Saturn
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly names Mars higher than Saturn as a separate negative source configuration

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: sickly and weakling
rules.historical_meaning_only: He asserts weakness from that configuration, not a validated health trait

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars in the sixt sudden casuall Diseases
rules.historical_meaning_only: A Mars-sixth conjunction is said to correlate with sudden recurrent disease, without observations

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars in twelfth extreme weakenesse
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars located in twelfth is alleged to yield extreme bodily weakness

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Infortune Matutine
rules.historical_meaning_only: Morning-status malefics are associated with sudden illness or falls

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if Vespertine long Diseases
rules.historical_meaning_only: Evening-status malefics are instead associated with long illnesses, a contrasting historical claim

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars in ascendant wounds or scars in face
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars rising is assigned a facial wound/scar result, not an independent injury history

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn in Mid-heaven sudden violent fals
rules.historical_meaning_only: Saturn in tenth is connected to falls and loss of status in a period anecdote

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: so cast men from their Preferment
rules.historical_meaning_only: The social-status consequence of the fall is distinct from actual physical injury

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: more testimonies of health fewer Diseases
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author proposes a count/direction rule without defining numerical weights or outcome horizon

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: major part Significators unfortunate weak or afflicted
rules.historical_meaning_only: The converse majority weak/afflicted source condition is explicitly stated

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: abundance of sicknesses
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly predicts many illnesses in the weak majority case, not an objective diagnostic measure

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn or Mars both Significator and author of Diseases
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author distinguishes a planet describing illness from one said to cause it; some can take both roles

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of ascendant or sixt house
rules.historical_meaning_only: A malefic ruler of first or sixth is a prerequisite for the combined role

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: weak and infected of the other Infortune
rules.historical_meaning_only: The combined source role is qualified by debility and hostile aspect of the other malefic

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Significator alone only weak
rules.historical_meaning_only: A weak indicator without the other malefic contact may be considered a mere signifier

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: only afflicted by other Infortune
rules.historical_meaning_only: Separate from inherent weakness, adverse aspect alone may define a signifier

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: author alone not Significator ... square or opposition
rules.historical_meaning_only: An attacking malefic outside significator role may be assigned alleged causality through hostile aspects

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: other Planets may be Significators not authors
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author treats non-malefics as illness indicators but usually not its causes, a distinct taxonomic rule

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortunes doubly afflicted imbecillity and malign aspects
rules.historical_meaning_only: Benefic planets may be labeled doubly affected by their own weakness plus malefic contact

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: effects more vehement when both ways
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author grades severe outcomes based on compounded conditions, with no clinical baseline

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: afflicted only one way threatens lesse
rules.historical_meaning_only: A single kind of adverse testimony is said to produce weaker effects than double affliction

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: aspect partill
rules.historical_meaning_only: Exactness of planetary aspect is proposed as a modifier of alleged symptom severity

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: proceeds from a Planet angular
rules.historical_meaning_only: An angular malefic is said to intensify disease testimony beyond equivalent non-angular sources

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: kinds or qualities of Diseases from nature of Significators
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source attributes type of illness to the traditional intrinsic nature of natal indicators

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Signe of Zodiack wherein Significators posited
rules.historical_meaning_only: Indicator's zodiac sign is separately used to assign proposed illness category

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: nature of Infortune infects Significators
rules.historical_meaning_only: An afflicting malefic's identity contributes another axis of alleged disease attribution

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: nature of Signe wherein malevolent Planet is
rules.historical_meaning_only: Sign of afflicting malefic is another separately selected illness-cause source

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: first Planet happy or unhappy secondly Signe
rules.historical_meaning_only: Near the end the author restates a four-dimensional disease cause/quality procedure

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: thirdly Infortune afflicts fourthly Signe possessed
rules.historical_meaning_only: The method includes two additional dimensions from the malefic and its sign, without an objective decision threshold

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: above the earth in manifest parts of Body
rules.historical_meaning_only: He associates above-horizon disease significators with visible/manifest body parts

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: under the earth private or occult members
rules.historical_meaning_only: Below-horizon indicators are assigned private/hidden body parts; no physiological mechanism

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Every House hath proper Diseases assigned
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author also invokes a disease association for each house, introducing another possible lookup

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: pag. 245 of our second part
rules.historical_meaning_only: The referenced earlier-house page is a bibliographic pointer, not locally verified table content in this batch

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: comparing one with another ... what Disease
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author advocates combining these many indicators to select a body part and illness retrospectively
